purpose: Reassess historical rare1/rare5 plus donor-recurrent Stage75 regulatory-module tails on authenticated pathology-blind TRAIN data while separating biological rarity from source/operator observability.

historical_rare1_rare5.interpretation: Strong source shift; not accepted as universal rare biology or prevalence anchors.

stage75_detection_residual_regulatory_ta.measurement_falsifier: Within each source, module score residualized on standardized detected-gene count plus quadratic detected-gene term; rare tail at source-specific residual mean + 2 SD.

stat1.interpretation: Strongest current donor-recurrent regulatory rare-program lead for target-discovery reassessment; not target authority and not causal STAT1 evidence.

stage75_detection_residual_regulatory_ta.remaining_falsifier: Prior quality audit found association with total summed log1p expression; detected-gene residualization alone does not close measurement-quality confounding.

priority_programs_for_reassessment.reason: donor recurrent across all three sources and largely unchanged after detected-gene residualization; broader measurement/source falsifiers remain
largest +2SD donor count among tested modules; requires same broader falsifiers
donor recurrent after detected-gene correction; useful alternate/control regulatory topologies
important historical diagnostic but strongly source shifted and therefore not a clean positive

required_tests: candidate-target preservation without added shortcut predictability

program_classes.SOURCE_SPECIFIC_BIOLOGICAL_PROGRAM: real within one source but not universal
program_classes.BIOLOGICAL_PROGRAM_PARTIALLY_OBSERVATION: biology survives but observability depends on operator

candidate_effect.C1: preserve universal/observation-limited biology, not source prevalence
candidate_effect.C3: evaluate rare query context within source and broad state
candidate_effect.C6: add rare query-context information beyond C1 without increasing shortcut signal
candidate_effect.C2: if active, relational rare structure must survive source-aware reassessment
candidate_effect.C4: if active, relational increment beyond C6 must be biological
candidate_effect.C5: regulatory specialist only after own qualification; Stage75 tail recurrence can prioritize tests but cannot grant C5 authority

forbidden_shortcuts: pool all cells and let source composition set rarity
regress away source before biological assessment
use cell count as donor replication
use global rare1/rare5 prevalence as truth
treat detected-gene residualization as complete measurement-confound closure
treat STAT1 donor recurrence as causal regulation or target selection
